<strong>Trois points à ne pas perdre de: Three points to keep in mind to ensure the sale of a business
Ce genre de mésaventure n’est pas rare p: This kind of mishap is not uncommon for young entrepreneurs. To better understand how to secure the sale of business assets in Quebec, La Converse contacted Christophe Robidas, senior director at Keller Williams Commercial, a group of real estate brokers. He shared three points that are essential to consider:
1. Bien analyser son bail (dès le départ: 1. Analyze your lease carefully (from the start)
La valeur d’un fonds de commerce repose: The value of a business largely rests on the lease, especially if the rent is below market price. Problems can arise, because the landlord then has every interest in taking back the space to rent it out at a higher price. Rather than letting a buyer benefit from a favourable lease and agreeing to a lease assignment, the landlord can impose a new lease at market price, which will cause the value of the transaction to drop for the seller.
Certains propriétaires imposent des clau:
Some landlords impose restrictive clauses (right of first refusal, new conditions, rent increases) that can cause the sale value to drop.
Expert advice: from the signing of the first lease, consult a lawyer specializing in commercial real estate to make sure the clauses don’t prevent any future resale.
2. S’entourer des bons experts: 2. Surround yourself with the right experts
La vente d’un fonds de commerce diffère: Selling a business differs from a standard real estate sale. The broker you choose must have experience in the type of business being sold (café, hair salon, grocery store, etc.), otherwise they risk misjudging the real value of the business.
Le vendeur doit aussi mobiliser une équi: The seller must also assemble a team – an accountant, a tax specialist and a lawyer – to structure the transaction and avoid pitfalls.
Avant même de communiquer avec un courti: Even before contacting a broker, you need to have your financial documents up to date, know your numbers (generally those of the last three years) and know what your business is really worth.
Être réaliste sur la rentabilité de son: Be realistic about your business’s profitability: a business that doesn’t generate a profit often has little value, even if a lot of money has been invested in it.
Il est aussi crucial d’informer et de gé: It is also crucial to inform and manage your staff properly to avoid departures that could weaken the business at the time of the sale.
